integrity: Same-model analytical reconstruction and bibliographic comparison; no claim of independent peer review, external certification or complete literature coverage.
scientific_limitations: Only the first large-exponent asymptotic for homogeneous nearest-neighbor energy on \(\mathbb Z^d\), \(d\ge3\), is established. Fixed-exponent sharp constants, the critical exponent, and nonquadratic energies are not computed; numerical finite-box checks are illustrative only.
title: Nearest-neighbor asymptotics of sharp supercritical lattice Sobolev constants
